تعتقدين (form VIII)
# تَعْتَقِدِينَ (taʕtaqidīna) /taʕ.ta.qi.diː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِعْتَقَدَ (iʕtaqada)
# تُعْتَقَدِينَ (tuʕtaqadīna) /tuʕ.ta.qa.diː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَقَدَ (iʕtaqada)
